facts.text: UTMB School of Nursing is an upper-division school that does not admit first-time freshmen; applicants must complete 60 semester credit hours of college prerequisites at another accredited institution.

sources.title: Undergraduate Programs | Bachelor of ... - UTMB School of Nursing
sources.quote: Can I take prerequisite courses at UTMB School of Nursing? No. UTMB School of Nursing is an upper division nursing school. You will need to attend a community college or another university to complete the prerequisite courses.

sources.title: Undergraduate Programs | Bachelor of ... - UTMB School of Nursing
sources.quote: Complete 60 semester credit hours of prerequisite coursework at a regionally accredited college or university. Before applying for admission, complete at least 40 of the 60 prerequisite hours, including all five life and physical sciences
